summary: Iteration 10 — Full backend + frontend QA of new Team Member Profiles / Badges / Challenges / Leaderboard / Team HQ module. 31/31 pytest cases pass (badge seed, challenge seed + scoping, ghost hiding, privacy rule, profile mutations, pins rules, owner-only 403 matrix across 12 endpoints, E2E credit flow, crew prompt flow after status walk, challenge lifecycle). All frontend flows pass: owner nav shows Team/Leaderboard/Challenges/Team HQ; role scoping enforced (crew ghost sees only crew challenges, sales only sales, marketing all, /team-admin redirects for non-owner); privacy honoured (crew viewing Junior shows NO stats/progress, gallery only); Team HQ credit E2E flow (add credit for Junior → 'Badge unlocked: First Haul!' + 'Behind the Wheel' + 'Credit added' toasts, row appears, delete confirms + removes); Badges tab Take-it-back UI with award-member-select + award-badge-select + revoke-badge-btn; invite button present (headless clipboard toast expected 'Couldn't copy'); role switcher owner→sales works; javante crew lands /today with proper nav. DB fully clean at end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py member_detail: privacy rule is enforced correctly by omitting `stats` and `progress` keys entirely for non-owner non-self viewers (not just zeroing them) — great defensive design.

server.py save_pins: input `payload.badge_ids` de-duped with dict.fromkeys and truncated [:3] BEFORE the unlocked check — that means passing 4 unlocked badge_ids saves only the first 3 (no 422). Matches spec.

server.py list_challenges: `finalize_due_challenges()` is called INSIDE the GET request path — every list request scans for expired challenges. Fine at seed scale (4 challenges) but should be moved to a scheduler if the challenge count grows into the hundreds.
server.py award_badge dedupes via key `{user_id}:{badge_id}` with $setOnInsert — re-award is a no-op (returns False). Confirmed via re-issuing First Haul with the same credit.

server.py delete_credit: deletes the credit but does NOT re-evaluate + revoke badges. Correct per UX (owner explicitly uses Badges tab Take-it-back to revoke). But the confirmation modal in UI already warns 'Badges already unlocked stay unless you take them back on the Badges tab' — nice.

server.py POST /credits: for team=crew requires role_tag driver|helper (422 otherwise). For team=sales it silently ignores role_tag (stored as None). Fine but the frontend passes 'closer' anyway — no bug, just noting.
TeamAdmin AdminCreditsTab uses `credit-member-select` with the /team/members list — same list that hides ghosts. Owner cannot credit a ghost, which is by design.
MemberProfile.jsx: rookie-card is always present even when member has real activity — spec says 'rookie card' style. This is a visual choice, not a bug.

Layout.jsx: `role: owner` gates the Team HQ nav item; App.js gates the /team-admin route through OwnerRoutes only. Non-owner hitting /team-admin gets a Navigate('*') fallback (redirect to their role home). Verified.

Frontend crew Copy Invite toast: clipboard.writeText throws in headless Chrome without the clipboard-write permission, so the fallback toast 'Couldn't copy. Try again.' shows. Acceptable per spec — button presence is the check.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (owner + crew ghost + sales ghost + marketing ghost + javante crew flows all pass; role scoping, privacy, credit E2E, badge revoke UI, invite button, role switcher, dashboard regression — all verified)
